mapper.select: SELECT LOG_ID, VOUCHER_ID, VOUCHER_NO, OPERATION_TYPE, OPERATION_STATUS, ERROR_MESSAGE, REMARK, OPERATOR_ID, OPERATOR_NAME, OPERATION_TIME, BOOK_ID, TENANT_ID, CREATE_TIME FROM TBL_VOUCHER_POSTING_LOG WHERE VOUCHER_ID = #{voucherId} ORDER BY OPERATION_TIME DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_VOUCHER_POSTING_LOG ( LOG_ID, VOUCHER_ID, VOUCHER_NO, OPERATION_TYPE, OPERATION_STATUS, ERROR_MESSAGE, REMARK, OPERATOR_ID, OPERATOR_NAME, OPERATION_TIME, BOOK_ID, TENANT_ID, CREATE_TIME ) VALUES ( SEQ_VOUCHER_POSTING_LOG.NEXTVAL, #{logData.voucherId}, #{logData.voucherNo}, #{logData.operationType}, #{logData.operationStatus}, #{logData.errorMessage}, #{logData.remark}, #{logData.operatorId}, #{logData.operatorName}, SYSDATE, #{logData.bookId}, #{logData.tenantId}, SYSDATE )
